items.title: The Rocky Road From Aggregate To Per Share Value: Anthropic
items.title_zh: The Rocky Road From Aggregate To Per Share Value: Anthropic
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：Summary - The world has not stayed still in the fifteen days since my original valuation, and both company-level and macro developments require an update to my valuation.；In this post, I will start with a general discussion of how share count is complicated by the existence of multiple classes of shares and stock-based compensation and argue that the absence of standardization has made share count the Wild West in investing, with consequences for both intrinsic valuation and pricing.；Since intrinsic valuation is about estimating how much you value individual shares in a company to make a judgment on whether a stock is under- or overvalued, the share count clearly matters, since having more shares outstanding will yield a lower value per share.
important_points: Summary - The world has not stayed still in the fifteen days since my original valuation, and both company-level and macro developments require an update to my valuation.

In this post, I will start with a general discussion of how share count is complicated by the existence of multiple classes of shares and stock-based compensation and argue that the absence of standardization has made share count the Wild West in investing, with consequences for both intrinsic valuation and pricing.

Since intrinsic valuation is about estimating how much you value individual shares in a company to make a judgment on whether a stock is under- or overvalued, the share count clearly matters, since having more shares outstanding will yield a lower value per share.

items.title: Musk accuses Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield restrictions in Ukraine
items.title_zh: Musk accuses Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield restrictions in Ukraine
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：SpaceX founder Elon Musk accused Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy of being untruthful about restrictions around Ukraine's Starshield network and said Kyiv wanted to use Starlink for offensive operations.；Asked at The New York Times' Dealbook Summit about Zelenskyy's claims that Starshield had been slowed down, Musk said, "That's false ...；I don't want to blow your mind, but Zelenskyy is not always truthful." His comments came after Zelenskyy on Wednesday said speed restrictions remained in place on Starshield, hampering Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian missile and drone strikes.

items.title: 沃什三种情景重塑AI叙事，全球科技股面临重新定价
items.title_zh: 沃什三种情景重塑AI叙事，全球科技股面临重新定价
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：{{aisd}} AI生成 免责声明 美联储主席凯文·沃什用一场讲话，为此前持续升温的AI叙事重新定调。；当地时间11月16日，沃什在旧金山“生产率与就业”特别工作组论坛上首次系统阐述人工智能的长期经济影响，并列出三种情景：生产率与增长同步提升；岗位替代快于再就业，增长加快但失业率上升；投资回报不及预期，估值收缩拖累经济。他强调，这些是示例情景而非预测，美联储在AI浪潮中的角色“既不是倡导者，也不是反对者”，但必须评估其影响的幅度、范围与时间。；AI不再被默认为“降息催化剂”，而成为美联储政策框架中需要持续监测的新变量。行业人士分析称，这意味着，美联储关注的不仅是AI能否推动生产率增长，也包括技术扩散可能带来的大规模就业调整，以及投资热潮降温后对经济的冲击。在此框架下，市场不再简单区分“好AI”与“坏AI”，而是削减对AI的整体风险敞口，科技股估值迎来重新审视。

AI不再被默认为“降息催化剂”，而成为美联储政策框架中需要持续监测的新变量。行业人士分析称，这意味着，美联储关注的不仅是AI能否推动生产率增长，也包括技术扩散可能带来的大规模就业调整，以及投资热潮降温后对经济的冲击。在此框架下，市场不再简单区分“好AI”与“坏AI”，而是削减对AI的整体风险敞口，科技股估值迎来重新审视。
